events.verdict: Hart (NYK) contests Thompson's (HOU) dunk attempt at the rim and the arm contact is marginal.
Brunson (NYK) brings his off-arm to Thompson's (HOU) side as he makes a move to the basket and the contact is marginal.
Towns (NYK) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact with Green (HOU) during his driving shot attempt. Although Green loses control of the ball, the contact is incidental.
Thompson's (HOU) shot attempt does not make contact with the rim and the shot clock expires.
Brooks (HOU) does not release the throw-in within five seconds.
Towns (NYK) is not in a legal guarding position in Brooks' (HOU) path, initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball. Any ensuing contact with Brunson (NYK) is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds resulting in a jump ball pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Brunson (NYK) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and there is no proximate foul on the play.
Brunson (NYK) maintains a forearm against Thompson's (HOU) body as he braces for the ensuing contact and Thompson loses control of the ball on his own accord as they come together.
Thompson (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position as Brunson (NYK) brings the ball up the floor.
Tate (HOU) initiates illegal body contact with Brunson (NYK), affecting his driving shot attempt.
Both Hart (NYK) and Achiuwa (NYK) get their hands on the ball and tie up Adams (HOU). Any contact by the players is incidental and a held ball is whistled between Hart and Adams.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Brooks (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Holiday (HOU) commits a take foul on Hart (NYK).
McBride (NYK) briefly grasps and releases Holiday's (HOU) jersey during the drive.
Thompson (HOU) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
